# Mike Speight

Senior Digital Consultant, Scrum Master, Agile Practitioner and UX/UI Architect.

Website:
https://mike-speight.co.uk

## About

Mike Speight is an experienced digital consultant with a career spanning UX/UI architecture, front-end development, Agile delivery, Scrum, project leadership and digital strategy.

He has delivered projects for organisations including the BBC, H&M, Thales, Ford, Pearson, London Borough of Waltham Forest, London Borough of Croydon and numerous private sector organisations.

## Key Topics

- Agile Delivery
- Scrum
- Project Management
- Digital Transformation
- UX Design
- UI Architecture
- Front-End Development
- Accessibility
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Digital Strategy
